messages:
sam: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to consolidate timeout guidance + context-fallback examples for SDK consumers. PR #6583. Wanted to sync on minimal examples we can land this week.

julia: linking it here — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6583 :eyes: looks small but touches both JS and Python snippets.

matt: skimmed — main ask is: show 3 patterns (1) short client-side timeout + graceful UI, (2) server-side retry with exponential backoff, (3) context-trim fallback when token budget exceeded.

sam: yep. also need to update the "Error reference" cross-ref from /docs/errors/429 to mention suggested fallbacks and a tiny code sample. right now the link points to an old playbook.

rachel: I can own updating the 429 section copy and the markdown anchors. tagging @julia for snippet verification.

julia: happy to verify. quick question on wording: do we call the fallback "context trim" or "context-aware fallback"? prefer short.

matt: prefer "context trim" in headings, and explain term in first line. keeps anchors short.

sam: agreed. small SDK note: Python snippet currently uses a blocking retry loop; we should show an async-friendly example using backoff + jitter. propose this tiny example:

```python
import time, random
for attempt in range(4):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt, timeout=2.0)
        break
    except TimeoutError:
        sleep = (2 ** attempt) * 0.1 + random.random() * 0.1
        time.sleep(sleep)
else:
    # fallback: call /generate with trimmed prompt or shorter model
```

julia: that looks good, but recommend using SDK builtin retry helper in the note (we'll show both). I'll add a one-liner for JS too.

docs-bot: deploy-check: CI for docs PR 6583 passed linkcheck, but failing snippet lint on line 42 (python example).

rachel: on it — probably indentation. will push a fix.

sam: timeline: can we aim to merge by EOD Thu? Marketing wants the 2-line expl for the release notes.

matt: yes, I can finish the context-trim expl and add a short test prompt set to verify regression.

julia: I'll verify snippets and update SDK examples to use the retry header (and mention when to prefer client-side vs server-side retry).

sam: perfect. next actions: rachel fixes anchors/snippet lint, julia updates SDK snippets, matt adds prompt tests. ping me when PR is green and I'll merge. :thumbsup:

rachel: pushed a tiny whitespace fix. docs-bot: rerun snippet lint?

docs-bot: snippet lint passed. all checks green.

sam: merging now. thanks everyone — I'll file a short follow-up to ensure internal runbook links point to the new anchors.

matt: follow-up idea: add a tiny checklist in the runbook: "verify UI graceful degradation, confirm retry idempotency, check telemetry for token-trim rates".

sam: adding that after merge. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
